_comment_top: This is a REFERENCE snippet, not auto-applied. Shows the hook registrations this project owns. Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json's `hooks` block manually — your real settings file likely has additional entries (format-on-save, agent-flow, rtk-rewrite, etc.) that must be preserved.
_comment_paths: Hook commands resolve the provider-neutral installed core from LEARNINGS_CORE_HOME, defaulting to $HOME/.local/share/learnings-md-system.
_comment_preflight: PreToolUse/Bash hosts preflight-gate.py — the advisory pre-flight gate. Fires ONLY on `gh pr create` (one firing per review unit); emits hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext with the root-cause-class questions from the neutral core's bin/preflight-gate-classes.json. Fail-open by design: any error exits 0 silently and never blocks the command — the `|| true` in the command string extends that to a missing/undeployed hook file (python exits 2 when it can't open the script, and PreToolUse treats exit 2 as a BLOCK). CHAINS with block-git-add-sweep.sh (separate PreToolUse/Bash entries, disjoint command patterns — sweep-staging vs PR creation — so at most one speaks per command).
_comment_design: Quiet corpus, Stage 1 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-quiet-corpus-stage1.md): no hook writes on a timer. The PostToolUse hook (learning-hook.py), PreCompact hook (learning-on-compact.py), SessionEnd hook (learning-on-end.py), and the SessionStart mine trigger (learning-mine-trigger.py) were deleted in the 2026-09-06 trim PR — remove any registration of them from ~/.claude/settings.json if present; the files no longer exist to run. SessionStart keeps THREE hooks in load-bearing order: commit-learnings.sh, learnings-register.sh, learning-on-start.py. Commit first snapshots a settled legacy corpus before registration may change authority. Registration second enrolls only exact $HOME/Code/<category>/<repository> Git roots. Orientation third observes that result and now also fires on compact. PostToolUseFailure hosts the only nudge to write.
